crossRefs.note: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in…
For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for…
His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that…
who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may…
So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out…

translations.web: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, it is good to be zealous if it serves a noble purpose—at any time, and not only when I am with you.
translations.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
translations.asv: But it is good to be zealously sought in a good matter at all times, and not only when I am present with you.
